resources.string: Enter 0 to 1,000,000,000 with at most two decimal places. Use a decimal point, without separators or a currency symbol.

All amounts use the same currency units with two decimal places (100 minor units per unit). No currency conversion is performed. Not suitable for currencies with a different number of minor-unit decimal places.
Tax is an amount, not a percentage. The tip is calculated on the original bill before tax, then rounded once to the nearest minor unit, with halves rounded up. Tax is not calculated for you.
Explicit History imports and saved setups restore inputs only; press Calculate split. If Remember results is enabled, reopening can restore the last completed split.
Extra minor units are assigned to the first diners in this numbered list so the shares add up exactly. The numbering is only a suggested allocation, not a payment or a contact list.
